lines: Create a trigger named phone_format_enforcer that activates before updating a record
in the courier_customers table. The trigger must ensure that whenever a customer's
phone_number is updated, the new value begins with '+91'.
If the updated phone_number does not start with '+91', the trigger should automatically
prepend '+91' to the value. If the phone_number already follows the required format, the
update should proceed without any modification. Existing records that are not part of
the update operation should remain unaffected.
